Ask the Historian

Ask about a regiment, a commander, a place, or a moment of the battle.

This runs entirely in your browser and answers only from this site's own published data -- 467 regimental records, 24 narrative vignettes, 137 chronology events, and 30 mapped terrain features. It is a search-and-synthesis tool, not a live AI model, so it can only tell you what's already in those records -- but everything it tells you traces back to a real row of data, shown as a source link below each answer.
